description: Multi-seed training convergence and variance reconciliation across protocols and standard deviation definitions

protocol_B_3000_samples_reproduced.provenance: Freshly evaluated on full 1500 test sources (3000 samples) on GPU

discrepancy_explanation: The numerical difference between 0.002955 and 0.0024/0.0020 stems from two distinct factors: (1) Sample size: Protocol A evaluated 1,000 samples (500 sources) yielding AUCs [0.8556, 0.8531, 0.8497], whereas Protocol B evaluated 3,000 samples (1,500 sources) yielding AUCs [0.8543, 0.8545, 0.8503] (reproduced) or [0.8543, 0.8502, 0.8499] (historical). (2) Degrees of freedom: In Protocol A, the population SD (ddof=0) is exactly 0.002413 (which rounds to 0.0024) while the sample SD (ddof=1) is 0.002955. In Protocol B historical, the sample SD (ddof=1) is 0.002458 (rounds to 0.0024) while population SD (ddof=0) is 0.002007 (rounds to 0.0020). A previous report mistakenly transposed the 0.0024 population SD of Protocol A with the 0.0024/0.0020 figures of Protocol B.
